reason: My guests pay a lot for the villa and they expect me, not a robot. I answer them myself, even at midnight, and I am not going to put a new one-person company between me and my guests.
objection: If this young company disappears or the AI tells a guest something wrong about the pool or check-in, it is my reviews on Booking that suffer, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it working for a full season at another high-end villa owner I know personally, with guests who were happy with it.
